parameters.query: SELECT ticker FROM trading.watchlist WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY ticker;

SELECT job_id, job_type, status, provider, instrument_selection_json, period_from, period_to, dry_run, overwrite_mode, progress_total, progress_completed, warning_count, error_count, last_error, heartbeat_at, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM trading.import_jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30;
SELECT job_id, status, count(*) AS anzahl FROM trading.import_job_items GROUP BY job_id, status;
SELECT * FROM trading.import_jobs WHERE job_type = 'market_data' AND status IN ('queued','running','pausing') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1;
=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = 'paused' WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND status = 'pausing';
=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()) WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND status = 'queued';
SELECT config_key, value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('IMPORT_DEFAULT_PACKAGE_SIZE', 'IMPORT_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS');

=SELECT * FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND (status = 'pending' OR (status = 'running' AND heartbeat_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')) ORDER BY sequence_number LIMIT {{ $json._package_size }};

=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = CASE WHEN error_count > 0 THEN 'completed_with_warnings' ELSE 'completed' END, finished_at = now() WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status IN ('pending','running')) AND status NOT IN ('completed','completed_with_warnings','cancelled');
=UPDATE trading.import_job_items SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()), attempt = attempt + 1, heartbeat_at = now() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET progress_completed = (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status = 'completed'), error_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status = 'failed'), warning_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status = 'skipped'), heartbeat_at = now() WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Paket-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}';
